Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API evaluation - demo request

Hi Marissa,

We just signed up for the Hosted API eval yesterday and I wanted to see if we could schedule a short demo to run through a few integration questions and validate latency/cost expectations for our use case. We're an ML-intensive analytics team evaluating a few providers — key items for us: VPC/private data handling, per-token cost at 8k context, and whether there are recommended quantization profiles for our workload.

We're based in Pacific Time. My availability next week is: Mon 12/13 10–12 PT, Tue 12/14 13–16 PT, Thu 12/16 morning. If none of those work, happy to share a Calendly link.

Attn: I'd like to include our platform engineer (cc'd on follow-ups) for the technical part.

Thanks,
Alex Mendes
Product Lead, BrightLayer
alex.mendes@brightlayer.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks for signing up, Alex — great to meet you virtually. We'd love to run a 30-minute Hosted API evaluation walkthrough and go over the points you called out.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Mon 12/13 10:30–11:00
- Tue 12/14 14:00–14:30
- Thu 12/16 09:00–09:30

Here's a short evaluation brief attached that covers how we think about cost, batching, and recommended quant profiles for common CPU/GPU footprints.

Quick agenda:
1) 10–12 minute demo of the Hosted API + model catalog
2) 10 minutes on integration patterns (KV cache, batching)
3) Q&A on security/VPC options and cost projections

If you confirm a slot I will send a calendar invite and loop in our infra engineer (Dev) for any deep technical questions. If you'd prefer a different time, send a couple of options and we'll reschedule.

Best,
